integrity: All scientific claims follow from a self-contained analytic proof; an independently coded transfer-matrix diagnostic passed 2578 finite assertions. Finite diagnostics do not prove the universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two equal-length piecewise-constant Fickian layers, Neumann endpoints, and one point absorber; no conclusion for general material profiles, non-Fickian conventions, several traps or finite-time objectives. Historical priority remains open for uninspected older full texts.
title: A universal placement bound for a partially absorbing trap in two-layer diffusion
